items.t: Oscar Health (OSCR) Stock May Still Be A Bargain Despite Raised Outlook
items.sum: Oscar Health has delivered a powerful multi year share price run, even after a recent pullback, which puts a spotlight on whether the current valuation can be explained by its earnings profile. With fresh headlines about expansion and product rollouts, the key issue for Oscar Health now is how much of that story is already reflected in the price investors are paying for each dollar of profit. items.t: Hy-Vee Health with Oscar Expands Across Iowa, Into Kansas City and Omaha for 2027 Open Enrollment
items.sum: DES MOINES, Iowa, November 18, 2026--Hy-Vee, Inc. ("Hy-Vee"), a leading grocery store in the Midwest, and Oscar, one of the fastest-growing insurers in the individual market and part of Oscar Health (NYSE: OSCR), today announced that Hy-Vee Health with Oscar is expanding statewide across Iowa and launching in Kansas City and Omaha for 2027 Open Enrollment.1
